items.description: NIRVFuzz is a simulation-based, coverage-guided fuzzing framework for RISC-V processor cores. It automatically generates and mutates sequences of RISC-V machine instructions, runs them through a Verilator simulation of the target CPU, and uses hardware-observable feedback signals to guide the search toward inputs that expose bugs.
